Challenge Trends is a trend-participation content stream with no antecedent in pre. Nearest PRE counterpart is Product Review; tested all four transformations — Challenge Trends is participation/entertainment, not product evaluation, so no tier is defensible. Conceptually different domain.

uncertainty.coder_notes: Taste Testing Videos → Product Review is the strongest pairing but still arguable because Product Review in food/product domains could mean either tasting or recipe demos. Recipe Content could alternatively be read as part of the Product Review umbrella, which would convert it from New to Expanded or Narrowed; however, recipe content (showing how to cook) and taste-testing reviews (sensory evaluation) are distinct enough to keep separate.
